scientific_integrity: The numeric constant was previously derived; only the exact nonnegative defect, complete equality structure, and sharp cone-distance bound are proposed as new. No independent audit asserted.
scientific_limitations: Real L4 only; stability is pointwise cone distance rather than distance to normalized global minimizers; priority against unindexed equivalent weighted quartic refinements remains open. The tau=1 case is classical.
title: A sharp quartic skew-Schäffer defect and two-ray extremizer rigidity on real \(L^4\)
